name: Thomas Strong

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Susannah Thompson; his father Selah Strong had come from Northampton, Mass., to Setauket in 1720.

sources.citation: B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 296
sources.supports: Thomas Strong m. 16 Aug 1734 Susannah Thompson; d. 14 May 1760; father Selah from Northampton 1720
